claim: Sets how many video frames each drawing is held for, so a value of 3 gives the classic 8fps anime chug and 1 gives smooth full animation. A director drops to 1 only on the cut that has to feel fluid, because on-2s and on-3s is what makes footage read as drawn rather than filmed.
not_visual: Drawing stepping only exists across frames. Every option produces the identical single frame, so a still panel cannot show any difference.
